description: This file contains inline template implementations for the Minidump file writer, including memory allocation and copying methods for different minidump data types, within the google_breakpad namespace.

classes.name: TypedMDRVA<MDType>
classes.description: Template class managing memory allocation and data copying for minidump data types within the minidump file writer.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory for a single minidump data object.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory for a single minidump data object with additional size.

methods.name: AllocateArray
methods.description: Allocates memory for an array of minidump data objects.

methods.name: AllocateObjectAndArray
methods.description: Allocates memory for a single object plus an array of data.

methods.name: CopyIndex
methods.description: Copies a data item at a specific index into the allocated memory.

methods.name: CopyIndexAfterObject
methods.description: Copies data after the object, at a specific index.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Writes the current data to the output via the writer.
